qt: to the Commission Ciaran Mullooly (Renew) Subject:

Regulation (EU) 2025/26501 removed the separate impact assessment deadlines previously provided for under Article 34 of the EU Deforestation Regulation2 and incorporated these assessments into the general review due by 30 June 2030. Can the Commission clarify the following: 1.
Why were the earlier impact assessment deadlines removed rather than retained alongside the revised implementation timetable?
What interim monitoring will be undertaken to identify adverse consequences for farmers before 2030?
Will the Commission commit to publishing interim findings and recommending corrective measures where disproportionate impacts are identified?

Regulation (EU) 2025/2650 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 19 December 2025 amending Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 as regards certain obligations of operators and traders, OJ L, 2025/2650, 23.12.2025, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/2650/oj. 2 Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 31 May 2023 on the making available on the Union market and the export from the Union of certain commodities and products associated with deforestation and forest degradation and repealing Regulation (EU) No 995/2010 (OJ L 150, 9.6.2023, p. 206, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2023/1115/oj). 1
